Created `src/lib/catalogName.ts` with `sizeFamilyKey`, a pure position-independent size-family key that strips whole-word size tokens (including slash-joined lists like `100G/200G` and unit-less chain members) anywhere in a normalized name, removes dangling punctuation, and returns `null` for sizeless or size-only names; `sizeVariantsOf` in `src/lib/catalogMeal.ts` and the family check in `src/lib/ai/coachCatalogSearch.ts` now use it (null-key items never count as family members), `sizeVariantKey` is deleted, and `src/lib/__tests__/catalogName.test.ts` covers leading/trailing/slash-joined/parenthesized sizes, decimal separators, and the no-token/size-only null cases.
